quiz.name: Quiz
quiz.description: Questions from the bank with automatic grading, time limits and attempts
quiz.perPage: New page every N questions (0 = all on one page)
quiz.completionPass: Grade is at least the pass grade
quiz.notOpen: The quiz is not open yet
quiz.empty: This quiz has no questions yet
quiz.pendingGrade: Waiting for the teacher to grade
quiz.question: Question {n}
quiz.finishConfirm: Finish the attempt? You will not be able to change your answers.
quiz.timeUp: Time is up; your attempt was submitted
quiz.locked: Students have attempts: the questions cannot be changed
quiz.bankEmpty: The course question bank is empty
quiz.timeWarning: Attention: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left

overrides.choose: Choose a participant or a group
overrides.hint: Empty fields come from the quiz settings. A participant’s settings win over group settings; across several groups the most lenient apply.

regrade.title: Regrade
regrade.hint: Recalculates finished attempts with the current questions and marks. Manual marks and essays are kept.
regrade.confirm: Regrade all finished attempts? Gradebook grades will change.

access.title: Access
access.passwordHint: Asked before each attempt starts (previews too). Leave empty for none.
access.subnetHint: Attempts only from these addresses: e.g. 192.168.1.0/24, 10.1 or 172.16.5.10-20. Empty: from anywhere.
access.delay1: Wait after the first attempt, min
access.navMethodHint: Sequential: pages in order, without going back to a page already left.
access.networkBlocked: This quiz can only be taken from certain network addresses, and yours is not one of them.
access.waitUntil: The next attempt can start on {date}.
access.sequentialNotice: Pages go in order: you cannot return to a page once you leave it.

behaviours.title: Question behaviour
behaviours.behaviourHint: Deferred: answers are graded when the attempt is finished. Immediate: each answer can be checked once. Interactive: after a wrong answer the learner sees a hint and tries again, losing the question’s penalty for each wrong try.
behaviours.duringFeedback: During the attempt, show feedback on checked answers and hints
behaviours.duringRightAnswer: During the attempt, show the right answer once a question is complete
behaviours.triesLeft: {n, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}

order.help: Put the items in order with the arrow buttons.

gaps.pick: Pick an answer, then the gap for it, or drag it there. Pick a filled gap to empty it.
gaps.wrongGroup: This answer does not go in gap {n}

errors.networkOnly: This quiz can only be taken from certain network addresses
errors.noQuestions: This quiz has no questions yet
errors.notEnoughRandom: Not enough questions in the random category
errors.pageLeft: That question is on a page you have already left
errors.noSuchQuestion: No such question in the attempt
errors.finishedUseReview: The attempt is finished; read it with review
errors.inProgress: The attempt is in progress; finish it first
errors.questionsLocked: Cannot change questions after attempts exist
errors.nextAttemptAt: The next attempt can start at {at}
errors.notOpenYet: The quiz is not open yet
errors.noGoingBack: This quiz goes page by page: you cannot go back
errors.gradedAtEnd: This question is graded when the attempt is finished
errors.answerBeforeCheck: Answer the question before checking it
errors.otherGroup: This attempt is of another group
errors.closeAfterOpen: Close date must be after open date
